name: Raquel Alucard
source:
[url=/c38548]Naoto's[/url] master and one of the main characters of the novel series Bloodedge Experiences. Her life-force value hovers around 80,000,000. She also appears in Naoto's version of Amane's Astral Heat, drinking tea while sitting on top of him. Being only two years old, she is pretty ignorant about the human world and common sense and wasn't even aware of what clothes are at first.

Raquel is shown to be headstrong and confident in her abilities as a combatant. When Naoto's arm gets severed, however, she does not think much of it, only saying how she was just 'careless'. She has a complicated relationship with her father, Clavis Alucard, only ever referring to him as 'that man'. 

She is also very weary of human behavior, having been told once that humans are cowardly and weak, believing that Naoto would be the same once he ran to find something to save her with, ultimately, she was proven wrong. Like other characters in the series who are weary of their small chest sizes, Raquel follows this rule and beats Naoto when he accidentally makes a comment on it. Raquel suffers from anxiety attacks when near anyone of the same gender, however, when the female is in a dire state, the attacks tend to not occur.

[spoiler]She is revealed to be inside Rachel's body all along; however, she can't surface herself and needs Rachel's permission in order to do so; but because Rachel's powers are decreasing every minute, she can take control more easily. She is also the one who sent Naoto to the main Blazblue's timeline, in order to save their own timeline. Because she is a creature created from the Boundary, she has a strong connection to it and can move from timeline to another easily.[/spoiler]
